column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way The Case With My Little Sister Is Closed
Yay, the case of Kiririn-shi's memory loss has come to a close! The world's at peace once again!
Don't close the curtains beautifully like that. In that closing sentence, you didn't include how much effort I put in and the suffering I went through up
until now, you know?
You reap what you sow. Even though nobody asked you to help, Senpai simply butted in, didn't you?
Right, right. There's nothing more troublesome than that.
Y-You all, could you please be a little kinder to me...?
As they surrounded the powerless me, Saori, Kuroneko and Kirino laughed.
Anyway, it's been quite a while since the four of us gathered like this. Because the daily schedules of us four don't really match up.
And today is the first day of Comiket.
We can't afford to miss this day, so everyone tried their best to reschedule their plans just to meet up.
If that's the case, I can't be depressed the entire time. I have to liven up for the first time in a while!
And here I thought you were depressed, why did you suddenly start grinning?
Y-You... how could you say that to your elder brother that has just pulled himself together?
Hehe... You're one to talk, your lips have been widening since earlier. Your face looks even rounder than before.
Wha-?! As if that could be?!
If you want a fight, I'll oblige you, you damn cat.
You mere human. I'll reduce you to ashes.
Ahh, an arranged play has once again started.
Hahaha, the two of them are the same as usual.
Yeah, that's true.
That's great. Kirino. You came to play with everyone once more.
However, we're about to reach the entrance, so it's about time to... stop...
Eh? This is?! Kiririn-shi, Kuroneko-shi, please keep quiet for a moment!
...Ah, this is my song...
We heard an amateurish denpa song the moment we stepped into the convention hall. But it really was quite a mysterious tune, which frightfully
stayed in your ears and somehow made your heart bounce excitedly the more you listened to it.
Ah, come to think of it, I received a notification the other day saying they were going to use it. I'd completely forgotten about it.
Don't lie, you brat.
You jumped for joy in the house the moment you knew it was going to be used, and you even boasted to me about it everyday.
Well, it's a song that I made, so it's only natural.
Yeah, as one would expect of Kiririn-shi. You are already a multi-talented girl of the female otaku world.
Right, right?! Well, anything I do will be of professional level.
Hmph, this is more commonly known as jack of all trades but master of none.
Fufu, are you jealous of me?
...I'm actually praising you.
However... We'll be here for the entire day, won't we? It'll really be unbearable if we have to listen to this denpa song for hours.
Isn't it fine? Revel in my talent fully.
Say, Saori. Are there any places here that sells earplugs?
Fufufu, Kyousuke-shi, you should listen to it as an elder brother.
Tch... Yes, yes. I get it.
Although that's what I said, I slowly placed my hands onto my ears.
H-Hey, why are you trying to plug your ears?!
That's obvious! If I listen to this kind of denpa for hours, my brain will melt or turn to jelly!
What did you say...!
Listen! Listen to it! Listen to my song!!
Guwa!
...In the end, even after the matter of her memory loss ended, the relationship between Kirino and I hasn't changed much from before.
However, I think that's good for now.
If our relationship were to change that easily due to Kirino's memories, I want to keep this comfortable distance for a little while longer.
...Yeah right... it's fine to think that way, right?
